say:1:1010414001:1.text: Hey there! You look tired. Do you need some help?
say:1:1010414001:1.source_cn: 你们好，看你们很累的样子，需要帮忙吗？

say:2:1010414002:1.text: Who the heck are you? This place ain't safe, you know! Get out of here already!
say:2:1010414002:1.source_cn: 你是谁啊？这附近不安全不知道吗？没事就快点滚。

say:4:1010414003:1.text: I am Rowan of the Mithril Consortium. I am here to attend the <style="highlight">Golden Banquet</style>. This is my invitation from Lord Franz.
say:4:1010414003:1.source_cn: 我是秘银商会的罗万，庄园的主人邀请我参加<style=...

say:6:1010414004:1.text: I don't care if you're the crown prince of Esperia! No one's allowed around these parts.
say:6:1010414004:1.source_cn: 不管你是客人的小孩还是来捣乱的小孩，都别在这附近晃悠。

say:7:1010414005:1.text: We don't have time to play with a bunch of twerps like you. Now scram.
say:7:1010414005:1.source_cn: 我们现在忙得很，没空逗小孩玩。

say:8:1010414006:1.text: ...Is that any way to treat a guest? I'll be sure to tell your employer all about this.
say:8:1010414006:1.source_cn: ……这就是你们对待客人的态度？我要转达给你们的主人。

say:9:1010414007:1.text:
By all means! Go ahead! And remind him to pay us our wages while you're at it!
These gruglins here just won't leave. No one in their right mind should be doing this job.
say:9:1010414007:1.source_cn: 我求你赶紧去，让老爷提前给我们结工资。\n这附近的咕布...

say:11:1010414009:0.text: It's time to leave, princeling. This way's blocked off. Go play somewhere else!
say:11:1010414009:0.source_cn: 走吧，小少爷，此路不通，你换个地方玩泥巴吧。
